final_answer:
Added `LazyFile.is_open` as a boolean property returning `self._f is not None` without calling `open()`.

Only `src/click/utils.py` was modified; no untracked files remain.

arguments.command:
@'
import sys
from io import StringIO
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from click.utils import LazyFile
f = LazyFile('unused', mode='w')
with patch.object(LazyFile, 'open', side_effect=AssertionError('unexpected open')):
    assert isinstance(LazyFile.is_open, property)
    assert f.is_open is False
    f._f = StringIO()
    assert f.is_open is True
    f.close()
    assert f.is_open is True
print('Property checks passed')
'@ | python -B -; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat; git --no-pager status --short --untracked-files=all
arguments.description: Verify property behavior and only requested file changed
